description:
Goal: a GitHub Actions workflow that runs on push and PR, executing `make ci` (alias for `make check` = fmt-check + lint + coverage). Repo is going public, so visible green CI on README signals quality.

Requirements:
- New file: .github/workflows/ci.yml
- Triggers: push to main, pull_request to main
- Single job on ubuntu-latest
- Install Rust stable toolchain (with rustfmt + clippy components)
- Cache cargo registry + target/ for speed
- Install `cargo-tarpaulin` (needed for `make coverage`'s 100% gate)
- Run `make ci`
- README.md: add a CI status badge near the top

Gates (per CLAUDE.md):
- tests: 100% coverage, all tests pass (`make ci` itself enforces this)
- docs: README badge added; mention CI in README if appropriate
- alignment: workflow honors the project's quality gates as defined in Makefile and docs/PRINCIPLES.md

Standard bl flow: claim, work in the worktree, `bl review` to squash, `bl close` from repo root.
title: Add GitHub Actions CI workflow running make ci
